arcade-cream.$description: Arcade Cream — Page background, product card surfaces, inset highlights on buttons

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, checkerboard tiles, all UI borders, card outlines, icon strokes

pixel-gray.$description: Pixel Gray — Hairline borders, card dividers, structural rules between grid cells

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Secondary surface tone, checkerboard shadow squares, shadow color

carbon.$description: Carbon — Deep neutral for illustration fills and the densest checkerboard tiles

muted-gray.$description: Muted Gray — Disabled/muted text on buttons and body copy

marquee-orange.$description: Marquee Orange — Top notification bar, marquee accents, brand signature

buy-green.$description: Buy Green — Filled ADD TO CART button — the only green purchase action

arcade.$description: Sole typeface across the entire interface — every heading, label, price, button, body and icon is set in Arcade. The 400/700 weight jump is the only hierarchy tool; using a second typeface would shatter the kiosk illusion.
